title: Quietly Quenched Spanish Duck Crema Catalana
description: A savory and kid-friendly Spanish dish featuring duck sauce in a crema catalana form, served in a molcajete, this low-carb friendly meal is perfect for a special occasion. It has a shattering texture that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, eggs, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the shredded cheese, chopped ham, and diced onion to the bowl and stir until the cheese is fully incorporated.
Pour the duck sauce into the bottom of a molcajete or individual ramekins.
Pour the cream mixture over the duck sauce in the molcajete or ramekins.
Place the molcajete or ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the molcajete or ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of sugar over the top of each crema catalana and caramelize with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
